facts.fact: Saskia 喊停并把一只手按在烤箱上，拦住 Lucy 开门，Lucy 愕然地看着她。
facts.anchor: “Stop!” Saskia puts her hand on the oven to prevent Lucy from opening it, and Lucy stares at her in bewilderment.

facts.fact: Saskia 让 Lucy 别开烤箱门，自己按下 OFF 键。
facts.anchor: “Leave the door closed,” Saskia says, pressing the OFF button.

facts.fact: 警报停下后，那阵刺耳声在 Lucy 耳里回响的节奏，和她祖父讲道时一模一样。
facts.anchor: In the silence, its frantic klaxon echoes in Lucy’s ears with the same cadence as her grandfather’s preaching.

facts.fact: Saskia 还算有分寸地露出窘态。
facts.anchor: Saskia has the grace to look sheepish.

facts.fact: Lucy 认定祖父眼里的她只是一个项目、一件东西、一只需要严厉牧人管束的罪羊。
facts.anchor: He saw a project, an object, a sinning sheep that required a firm shepherd.

facts.fact: Saskia 从背后抱住 Lucy，说她身上没有任何毛病，只是自己不想伤到她。
facts.anchor: “There is absolutely nothing wrong with you. I just don’t want to hurt you.”

facts.fact: Saskia 说在她身边的人会受伤，然后套用泰勒·斯威夫特歌词把问题揽到自己身上。
facts.anchor: “People get hurt around me. So it’s not you, it’s me, hi, I’m the problem, it’s me.”

facts.fact: Lucy 追问为什么不能随心所欲，Saskia 只答因为有人会受伤。
滚汤溅到 Lucy 背上，Saskia 看过红痕后退开，说这就是「有人受伤」。
Roger 举着手机说明自己是收到火警提示才进屋的。
facts.anchor: “I got an alert that a fire alarm went off in here.”

facts.fact: Roger 发现原来插着摄像头的位置空了，像毛毛虫一样的浓眉皱了下来。
facts.anchor: His wild caterpillar eyebrows draw down.

facts.fact: Lucy 想明白 Roger 能直接进屋，是因为 Saskia 没关门。
facts.anchor: Oh—because Saskia left the door open.

facts.fact: 章末 Lucy 反问 Saskia 到底去了哪里。
